author: Bellular News
description:
EA's staff memo lays out a future built around sports, shooters and fewer people. BioWare doesn't fit. With $20 billion of debt to service, what happens to Mass Effect, Dragon Age and the rest of EA's abandoned catalogue?

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
